title: governance/signals.yml
description: Structural validator for Compass's signals.yml - the file that ships pattern defaults consumed by the stop-hook (scope-bloat phrases) and `compass rework-scan` (window + public-surface + migration patterns). Projects override by editing their own governance/signals.yml; the schema is the contract.

version.description: Semver. Bump on incompatible schema changes.

scope_bloat_phrases.description: Substrings searched in agent-authored text (devlog, verification-report) by the stop-hook to prompt a re-assessment. Case-insensitive substring match - not regex.

window_days.description: Lookback window for `compass rework-scan`. Issues landed outside this window are not considered as candidates for the add→delete pairing.

public_surface_patterns.description: Regex patterns for paths/symbols whose churn within window_days is reported as a separate signal class (public-surface rework).

migration_paths.description: Glob patterns for migration files whose churn within window_days is reported as a separate signal class (migration rework).

design_smell.description: Advisory patterns assessed by the reviewer agent at verify - judgment, never a gate. A match is a prompt to investigate a potential design problem. Projects extend by editing their own signals.yml.

friction.description: Config for the framework's self-calibration friction signal, aggregated by `compass retro --friction`. Advisory only - never a gate.

recurrence_threshold.description: Number of distinct issues that must independently propose the same change before it is reported as a recurring pattern. Below it, an item is noise, not a trend. Defaults to 2 when absent.
